scope: field-test corrections from brother report + remote multi-selection fix
confirmed_root_causes: RC1 had two independent routines competing for floating panel geometry: JourneyBubbleController and BubbleRuntimePolish0265.
Backend report-selection endpoint cleared sibling selections before selecting a new offer.
changes: Stop BubbleRuntimePolish0265 from writing panel width; JourneyBubbleController remains the sole width owner.
Reduce polish fallback polling from 450 ms to 1500 ms and react to actual panel layout changes.
Keep compact content while excluding footer controls from generic compaction.
Remove green/yellow/red offer-card outline and old verdict underline; keep verdict color on dot and category name.
Present destination continuity compactly as % Alto / % Médio / % Baixo.
Rename camera menu options at runtime to Jornada / Histórico and keep that area out of generic compaction.
Make backend report selection independent per offer instead of exclusive per journey.
reader_note: The RC2 intentionally does not claim to solve remaining HUD misses. Field failures must be marked with Registrar falha and followed by Configuracoes > Diagnostico de leitura so the next reader change is evidence-based.
